calculation.description: Fades the average three-session overnight gap: assets with recent positive gaps receive lower scores and assets with negative gaps receive higher scores. The signal at date t uses only opens and closes through t, and predicts next-session cross-sectional return.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive in 2020-2022 (0.035434; ICIR 0.123561), 2023-2024 (0.029685; 0.087211), and 2025-2026 (0.015651; 0.050957), though recent performance weakened.
